meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会写一个驱动脚本，在 pty 里无头运行引擎应用，录制每一帧并编码成视频，记录每条检查的通过/失败，最后用 pixel open 打开含视频、时间线、检查表的 summary 页面。
howto.when: 当你要验证引擎应用的界面行为（点击、滚动、输入等）时接管；每次验证都会被录制，并以 summary 页面结尾。

say.text: 验证一下滚轮滚动时画面有没有重绘，并录下来
模拟点击编辑器中间，检查选择是否生效
say.note: 点击坐标取自真实帧缓冲尺寸

say.text: 跑完打开 summary，看有没有 FAIL 行
say.note: 检查表按行显示通过与否

howto.what_en: Claude writes a driver script that runs your engine app headlessly in a pty, records every frame into a video, logs each check as pass or fail, and opens a summary page (video, timeline, checks) with pixel open.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to verify an engine app's on-screen behavior, such as clicks, scrolling or typing. Every verification is recorded and ends with a summary page.

say_en.text: Verify that the view redraws on wheel scroll and record it
Simulate a click in the editor center and check the selection
say_en.note: Click coords come from the real framebuffer size

say_en.text: Open the summary afterwards and look for FAIL rows
say_en.note: Checks table shows pass or fail per row
